text: After a botched ATM robbery, the troubled Kylie Bucknell is [sentenced to eight months of house arrest|trigger|cut off and trapped] in her mother Miriam's house, wearing an ankle monitor that will alert the police if she leaves. Miriam insists the house is haunted, and after [a disembodied hand grabs her in the basement|images|ghosts and strange figures] Kylie starts to agree, helped by Amos, the security contractor who returns with ghost hunting equipment. Then her step-father Graeme reveals that the house was once [a halfway house and the site of a horrific murder|origin|places with dark pasts].
